from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionRecord(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted for a single month from a Census/HUD housing construction report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month of the data in YYYY-MM format")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released in YYYY-MM-DD format")
    nsa_starts: float | None = Field(description="Not Seasonally Adjusted total housing starts in thousands")
    nsa_completions: float | None = Field(description="Not Seasonally Adjusted total housing completions in thousands")
    sa_units_under_construction_current: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted total units under construction for the reported month in thousands")
    sa_units_under_construction_previous: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted total units under construction for the previous month in thousands")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_records: list[MonthlyConstructionRecord]
